topics.name: Probability
topics.description: Probability theory, random matrices, stochastic differential equations, interacting particle systems, mean-field limits, propagation of chaos, optimal transport, concentration of measure, high-dimensional probability, Gaussian processes, spin glasses, percolation, Markov chain mixing, stochastic analysis with connections to statistics and machine learning.

topics.name: Statistics theory
topics.description: Mathematical statistics, high-dimensional statistics, minimax rates, nonparametric estimation, Bayesian asymptotics, causal inference, conformal prediction, uncertainty quantification, multiple testing, selective inference, robust statistics.

topics.name: Differential geometry

topics.name: Partial differential equations

topics.name: Harmonic analysis

topics.name: Complex analysis

topics.name: Combinatorics

topics.name: Mathematical physics
topics.description: Rigorous statistical mechanics, quantum mechanics and spectral theory, Schrodinger operators, random matrices in physics, integrable systems, gauge theory, mathematical general relativity, nonlinear PDE from physics, rigorous results on phase transitions.

topics.name: Optimization and control
topics.description: Convex and nonconvex optimization, first-order methods, convergence rates, stochastic optimization, optimal control, stochastic control, reinforcement learning theory, control barrier functions, safety verification, mean-field games.

topics.name: Machine learning theory

topics.name: Chemistry and materials
